4452184795.descriptionHtml:
About CTeBS

CTeBS, a subsidiary of Classic Fashion, is a leading software solution provider to the apparel manufacturing industry globally. Our flagship product, Trendz CMP, leverages cutting-edge technology to enhance productivity, quality, and efficiency for our clients worldwide. We are in an exciting phase of expansion and are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to drive the technical evolution of our core enterprise engineering team.


Role Summary We are seeking an experienced, self-driven Senior Software Engineer to own, architect, and deliver complex, mission-critical modules across our enterprise product suite. In this role, you will collaborate directly with the Lead Architect and Technical Leadership to design high-throughput systems, set engineering best practices, and mentor mid-level and junior developers. You will go beyond feature implementation by actively shaping technical design, reducing system complexity, optimizing database performance, and driving overall code quality.


Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Ownership & Design: Design, and implement complex, highly scalable features for mission-critical core modules, such as the Production Planning Engine
  • Architecture & Standards: Translate high-level architectural visions and Technical Design Documents (TDDs) into robust, clean, and maintainable Java/J2EE architectures while contributing to overall technical design decisions.
  • Full-Stack Implementation: Build responsive, performant Angular UI components aligned with enterprise data-flow standards, backed by resilient Spring Boot RESTful microservices.
  • Database Engineering & Performance: Design complex schemas, write optimized SQL, and develop high-performance stored procedures for MSSQL/Oracle databases. Analyze execution plans and optimize low-performing queries.
  • Code Governance & Mentorship: Lead rigorous code reviews focused on maintainability, security, and performance. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through pair programming and architectural guidance.
  • Technical Debt & Refactoring: Proactively identify technical debt, benchmark system performance, and propose targeted refactoring strategies to the Lead Architect.
  • Production Excellence: Diagnose and resolve complex production issues, including memory leaks, thread locks, concurrency bugs, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with QA lead, Business Analysts, and Product Managers to define edge cases, clarify ambiguous requirements, and streamline the release lifecycle.


Qualifications

  • Experience: 7+ years of hands-on professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-scale platforms.
  • Backend Mastery: Deep proficiency in Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Hibernate/JPA, Multithreading, and concurrent programming techniques.
  • Frontend Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Angular component architecture, state management, reactive programming (RxJS), and RESTful API integration.
  • Database Optimization: Solid expertise in MSSQL or Oracle, including advanced indexing, query tuning, stored procedures, and execution plan analysis.
  • Software Design: Advanced understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles, clean architecture, and common design patterns (e.g., Factory, Singleton, Observer, Strategy).
  • DevOps & Tooling: Hands-on experience with CI/CD automation (Jenkins, GitLab CI), version control (Git), containerization (Docker), and automated code analysis tools (SonarQube).
  • Problem-Solving: Proven ability to work independently, translate high-level business goals into scalable technical solutions, and troubleshoot complex production environments.
  • Communication: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate technical trade-offs, risks, and design choices to both technical teams and business stakeholders.


Technical Stack

  • Backend: Java, J2EE, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Multithreading, RESTful Microservices
  • Frontend: Angular, Typescript, RxJS, HTML5/CSS3
  • Databases: MSSQL, Oracle, Stored Procedures, Index Tuning
  • DevOps & Quality: Git, Jenkins / GitLab CI, Docker, SonarQube


Why Join Us At CTeBS, you will tackle enterprise-scale technical challenges in a niche global industry where software directly drives operational success. Your code will power manufacturing facilities across the globe. Working alongside software architects and business leaders, you will have direct influence over product architecture and team culture, placing you on a fast-track trajectory toward a Principal Engineer or Software Architect role.

4448601161.descriptionHtml:
Job Title - Architect Java - Associate Manager - ACS Song

Management Level: Level 8: Associate Manager

Location: Kochi

Must have skills: Java, Spring Boot, E-Commerce Platforms

Good to have skills: Agile Project Management, AI-Assisted Development Practices

Experience: 8-12 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)

Job Summary

We are seeking a Java Architect (Entry-Level Architect) with 8–12 years of strong hands-on experience in architecting and developing scalable, secure, and high-performance backend systems, with hands-on experience delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on platforms such as commercetools, SAP Commerce, Adobe Commerce, or Salesforce Commerce Cloud etc.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical leadership skills and deep expertise in modern Java ecosystems, distributed systems, microservices, cloud platforms, DevOps practices, and composable/headless commerce architecture.

Roles And Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the technical architecture for Java-based microservices and backend systems
  • Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, and technical decision-making
  • Establish coding standards and maintain high-quality, secure implementation practices
  • Implement best practices for performance, concurrency, caching, and database efficiency
  • Design, develop, and optimize Java/Spring Boot services, REST APIs, and integrations
  • Break down complex problems, lead end-to-end execution, and ensure timely delivery
  • Support CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and deployments on Kubernetes/cloud environments
  • Ensure observability through proper logging, metrics, monitoring, and distributed tracing
  • Troubleshoot production issues, lead root cause analysis (RCA), and implement long-term stable fixes
  • Enforce security best practices across services, APIs, and infrastructure integrations
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (QA, DevOps, Product) throughout the delivery lifecycle
  • Conduct code reviews and architecture reviews with a focus on quality and maintainability
  • Mentor junior engineers and foster a culture of continuous learning and engineering excellence
  • Champion adoption of AI-assisted development practices to improve team velocity and code quality


Professional and Technical Skills:

  • Strong expertise in Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and microservices architecture
  • Experience designing and building REST APIs and distributed backend systems
  • Good knowledge of JVM performance tuning, concurrency, threading, and memory management
  • Solid understanding of JPA/Hibernate, SQL, and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • Hands-on experience with caching mechanisms (Redis, Hazelcast)
  • Familiarity with messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS/SNS)
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-native design patterns
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
  • Strong understanding of observability tools: ELK Stack, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
  • Awareness of security practices: OAuth2/OIDC, TLS/mTLS, secrets management, and secure coding principles
  • Proficiency with Git and modern version control workflows
  • Ability to lead code reviews, participate in design reviews, and mentor junior engineers
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, AI-powered code review)


Good To Have:

  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum delivery frameworks
  • Exposure to platform engineering concepts and Internal Developer Platform (IDP) tooling
  • Familiarity with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra)
  • Experience with service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd)
  • Understanding of API gateway patterns and tools (Kong, AWS API Gateway, Apigee)
  • Experience designing and delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions using platforms such as commercetools, SAP Commerce, Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, or similar platforms
  • Strong understanding of composable/headless commerce architecture, including API-first design, microservices, event-driven architecture, and cloud-native patterns

4449547340.description: DescriptionAbout Opalus and OPALOpalus Investments Limited is developing OPAL, an AI-powered SaaS business operating platform for SMEs. OPAL places accounting at the core and connects finance, customers, people, projects, documents and workflow in one secure operating environment. We are establishing our software development team and office in Kochi, Kerala.The opportunityBuild reliable backend services for OPAL’s accounting, banking, reporting, identity, workflow and integration capabilities.What you’ll doDesign and implement services for general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, banking and reporting workflows.Implement tenant-aware business logic, permissions, data access and audit controls.Develop secure, well-documented REST and, where appropriate, GraphQL APIs.Integrate OPAL with CRM, payroll, recruitment, banking and other external services.Build audit logging, validation and compliance controls into transactional workflows.Improve performance, reliability and data integrity for high-volume financial processing.Support localisation, multi-company and multi-currency requirements.Contribute automated tests, code reviews, technical documentation and production support.Company descriptionOpalus Investments Limited is developing OPAL, an AI-powered SaaS business operating platform for small and medium-sized businesses. 4449547340.descriptionHtml:
Description


About Opalus and OPAL

Opalus Investments Limited is developing OPAL, an AI-powered SaaS business operating platform for SMEs. OPAL places accounting at the core and connects finance, customers, people, projects, documents and workflow in one secure operating environment. We are establishing our software development team and office in Kochi, Kerala.


The opportunity

Build reliable backend services for OPAL’s accounting, banking, reporting, identity, workflow and integration capabilities.


What you’ll do

  • Design and implement services for general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, banking and reporting workflows.
  • Implement tenant-aware business logic, permissions, data access and audit controls.
  • Develop secure, well-documented REST and, where appropriate, GraphQL APIs.
  • Integrate OPAL with CRM, payroll, recruitment, banking and other external services.
  • Build audit logging, validation and compliance controls into transactional workflows.
  • Improve performance, reliability and data integrity for high-volume financial processing.
  • Support localisation, multi-company and multi-currency requirements.
  • Contribute automated tests, code reviews, technical documentation and production support.


Company description

Opalus Investments Limited is developing OPAL, an AI-powered SaaS business operating platform for small and medium-sized businesses. With accounting at its core, OPAL is designed to connect finance, banking, customers, people, recruitment, projects, documents, workflow and reporting in one secure operating environment. A permissioned AI layer is being designed across the connected business record to help users understand information, prepare work and take controlled action with appropriate approvals and audit trails.


The company has completed a high-fidelity working prototype and is building the production-grade platform for an initial Australian release. Opalus is now establishing a software development office and multidisciplinary product team in Kochi, Kerala, to help take OPAL through engineering, testing, release and ongoing product development.


Requirements


What you bring

  • 7–12 years of backend engineering experience.
  • Degree in Engineering.
  • Strong commercial experience with Java 17+, Spring Boot, Hibernate/JPA, PostgreSQL, and sound relational data-modelling practices.
  • Experience with Redis and event or messaging platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
  • Experience securing APIs using JWT, OAuth 2.0 and related identity patterns.
  • Strong unit, integration and contract-testing practices, along with experience working in Agile or Scrum environments and with CI/CD.
  • Understanding of multi-tenant SaaS design and distributed-system fundamentals.
  • Experience in accounting, ERP, banking or FinTech domains.
  • Experience integrating with Xero, MYOB or comparable accounting platforms.
  • Exposure to AWS or Azure and containerised production environments.
  • Eligible to work in India.


Location requirement

This position is based in Kochi, Kerala, India. Applicants must already be based in Kochi or be willing to relocate to Kochi.


You must be eligible to work in India.

4446257345.descriptionHtml:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Application Developer: AWS Cloud FullStack, you will work in a modern cloud-native environment, building solutions around microservices, API-driven architectures, and continuous release cycles. You will collaborate with teams to deliver scalable and resilient applications using Agile methodologies. Your primary responsibilities will include:

  • Develop Rich UI Applications: Design and implement rich user interface applications using Single Page Applications (SPA) or microfrontends, utilizing frameworks such as ReactJS or Angular.
  • Build Scalable Backend Microservices: Develop scalable and resilient backend microservices based on 12-factor principles, exposing functionality via API and event interfaces, using programming languages such as Java, NodeJS, or Python.
  • Implement Data Modeling: Design and implement data models using modern SQL and No-SQL modeling techniques, ensuring data consistency and integrity.
  • Develop Event-Driven Applications: Build event-driven applications using Kafka, Zookeeper, and other hyperscaler cloud services, ensuring seamless communication between microservices.
  • Manage AWS Services: Run and manage services on AWS, including PaaS, routing services, databases, event-driven services, observability, and DevSecOps tools, ensuring efficient and secure application deployment.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Cloud-Native Development Experience: Exposure to developing applications in a modern cloud-native environment, utilizing microservices, API-driven architectures, and continuous release cycles via Agile methodologies.
  • Programming Language Proficiency: Experience with one or more programming languages, including Java, NodeJS, Python, or .Net, and proficiency in frameworks such as Springboot, Quarkus, Django, or Express Js.
  • Data Modeling Knowledge: Experience with modern SQL and No-SQL modeling techniques, including data model design and implementation.
  • Hyperscaler Cloud Services: Exposure to hyperscaler cloud services, including Kafka, Zookeeper, and AWS services such as EKS, ECS, Fargate, Lambda, and API Gateway.
  • DevSecOps Tools: Experience with DevSecOps tools, including CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CodePipeline, CodeCommit, and observability tools such as CloudWatch and X-Ray.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Proficiency in Additional Frameworks: Experience with frameworks such as Quarkus, Django, or Express Js, in addition to Springboot, is beneficial for building scalable and resilient backend microservices.
  • Knowledge of Multiple Programming Languages: Exposure to multiple programming languages, including Java, NodeJS, Python, or .Net, can enhance development capabilities in a modern cloud-native environment.
  • Familiarity with AWS Services: Experience with various AWS services, including CloudFront, Lambda@Edge, and AWS MSKafka, can be advantageous in managing and deploying applications on AWS.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Senior level)

Description

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is a modern way of delivering IT Solutions by imbibing Software engineering principles in Service Delivery to reduce IT Risk to business, improve business resilience, attain predictability & reliability, optimize cost of IT Infra and Ops

A Site Reliability Engineer typically has deep software engineering experience encompassing design, build, deploy and manage / maintain an IT solution ensuring resilience, reliability, and performance.

An SRE is a bridge between development and operations by applying a software engineering mindset to the development, deployment, and maintenance of applications to maximize system reliability & automation, while improving efficiencies by optimizing resources

Responsibilities

  • Defining SLA/SLO/SLI for a product / service
  • Engineering in resilient design and implementation practices into solutions as they go through the product life cycle
  • Engineering out manual effort (Toil) through the development of automated processes and services (e.g., Automated Management of Systems, CI/CD improvements)
  • Developing Observability Solutions to track, report, and measure SLA adherence
  • Help Optimize Cost of IT Infra & Operations - FinOps
  • Critical Situation management
  • SOP / Runbook automation, Toil reduction
  • Data Analytics & System trend analysis

Typical Skills And Background

  • 7+ years of experience in software product engineering principles, processes and systems
  • Hands-on experience in Java / J2EE, one of web server (Apache Tomcat or IBM HTTP Server), one of the application servers (Tomcat/WebSphere), and any major RDBMS like Oracle
  • Hands-on experience in at least one CI-CD (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins) and IaC tools (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible etc.)
  • Experience in at least one cloud technology (AWS/Azure/GCP etc. and Docker, Pivotal, Kubernetes, OpenShift etc.) and its reliability tools (Azure AppInsight, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor etc.)
  • Experience in Linux (RHEL) operating system performance monitoring parameters and their interpretation, commands used for monitoring
  • Experience in Observability - APM tools (Dynatrace, AppDynamics etc.), metrics / log consolidation (Splunk) and ELK Stack
  • Defining NFRs and SLA/SLO/SLI agreement for a product / platform / services
  • Knowledge on queuing models used, thread pools, request servicing processes etc.
  • Knowledge in Web Services, SOA, ESB (DataPower), RESTFul
  • Knowledge of application design patterns, J2EE application architectures, Microservices, Spring boot & Cloud native architectures
  • Proficiency in Java runtimes, Core Java, Garbage collection, JVM parameters tuning
  • Experience in performance tuning on Application Servers (Tomcat/WAS)
  • Experience in trouble shooting Performance / Scalability / Availability issues
  • Experience in Thread dump, heap dump generation & analysis
  • Knowledge on Query tuning and database designs & models
  • Knowledge at least one automation scripting language like Python
  • Mastery in collaborative software development using Git, Jira, Confluence etc.
  • AI/ML & Data Analytics knowledge and experience is a desirable

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Job Title - Sr. Architect Java - Manager - ACS Song

Management Level: Level 7 - Manager

Location: Kochi

Must have skills: Java, Spring Boot, Microservices Architecture, E-Commerce Platforms

Good to have skills: Agile Project Management, AI-Assisted Development Practices, Platform Engineering

Experience: 13-15 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Java Architect with 13–15 years of experience in architecting, modernizing, and governing large-scale enterprise applications and platforms, with proven expertise in delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on platforms such as commercetools, SAP Commerce, Adobe Commerce, or Salesforce Commerce Cloud etc.

The ideal candidate should possess strong technical leadership skills, deep expertise in modern Java ecosystems, distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, composable/headless commerce architecture, and enterprise architecture practices. The role requires driving architecture strategy, technology modernization, governance, and engineering excellence across multiple teams and delivery programs.

Roles And Responsibilities

  • Define and drive domain-level and enterprise architecture strategy for Java-based platforms and distributed systems
  • Lead architecture governance, design reviews, and technical decision-making across multiple teams and programs
  • Establish architecture standards, design principles, and reusable engineering patterns
  • Conduct technical risk assessments, production issue reviews, root cause analysis, and define long-term remediation strategies.
  • Design scalable, resilient, secure, and high-performance cloud-native applications and microservices
  • Drive adoption of modern architectural patterns including Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Event-Driven Architecture (EDA), and API-first design
  • Define and enforce best practices for performance, scalability, reliability, observability, and security
  • Support DevSecOps adoption, CI/CD maturity, cloud governance, and operational excellence initiatives
  • Lead cloud transformation, platform engineering, and legacy application modernization initiatives
  • Guide teams through architecture, design, development, and deployment of complex programs
  • Evaluate and recommend emerging technologies aligned with business and technology strategy
  • Champion adoption of AI-assisted development practices to improve engineering velocity and quality
  • Partner with business stakeholders, product teams, and delivery leadership to align technology solutions with business objectives
  • Mentor architects, technical leads, and senior engineers
  • Foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and engineering excellence


Professional and Technical Skills:

  • Expert-level proficiency in Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and microservices architecture
  • Strong knowledge of JVM performance tuning, concurrency, threading, and memory management
  • Extensive experience designing and governing enterprise-scale distributed systems and cloud-native applications
  • Deep understanding of DDD, EDA, API-first design, CQRS, and enterprise integration patterns
  • Solid understanding of JPA/Hibernate, SQL, and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • Hands-on experience with caching technologies (Redis, Hazelcast) and messaging platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS/SNS)
  • Deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-native architecture patterns
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD platforms (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
  • Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent)
  • Strong understanding of observability tools: ELK Stack, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
  • Knowledge of security practices: OAuth2/OIDC, TLS/mTLS, secrets management, secure coding, and DevSecOps principles
  • Proficiency with Git and modern code management/version control workflows
  • Experience leading architecture reviews, governance processes, and technology standardization
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, AI-powered code review)


Good To Have:

  • Experience with Agile delivery framework and multi-team program governance
  • Exposure to platform engineering concepts (Internal Developer Platforms, golden paths)
  • Familiarity with polyglot persistence strategies and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB)
  • Experience with service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd)
  • Contributions to open-source projects or architecture communities
  • Experience designing and delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions using platforms such as commercetools, SAP Commerce, Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, or similar platforms
  • Strong understanding of composable/headless commerce architecture, including API-first design, microservices, event-driven architecture, and cloud-native patterns

4455585870.descriptionHtml:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for a seasoned, hands-on .NET developer with strong systems design and architecture experience to join our search engineering team. This role will work on the backend services and search APIs powering our critical applications, and will be trained on our search platform technologies.

This is a full-time position and reports directly to the VP, Data Architecture.

Preferred Location

Qualified candidates should be based in or near Kochi and able to work from our Kochi office as part of a hybrid schedule.

Essential Functions

Backend & API Engineering (.NET)

  • Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable RESTful APIs using .NET Core (C#) to support both internal systems and client-facing applications
  • Architect and implement authentication, authorization, and entitlements/access control systems to protect API endpoints and user data
  • Contribute to system design discussions, producing scalable, fault-tolerant architectures for distributed systems and applying event-driven patterns where appropriate
  • Collaborate with data engineering teams to design and optimize data ingestion and enrichment pipelines that feed search indexes
  • Incorporate AI coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, etc.) into daily workflows; review and validate AI-generated code before merging
  • Ensure code quality through unit, integration, and performance testing; participate in code reviews and uphold engineering standards

Search Platform Engineering

  • Contribute to our scalable search infrastructure built on Apache Solr and/or OpenSearch, including schema design, indexing pipelines, and query parsing
  • Apply or develop knowledge of search relevance concepts: tokenization, stemming, custom analyzers, boosting rules, and query-time vs. index-time tuning
  • Support search cluster operations, replication, and high-availability in production environments
  • Help diagnose and resolve search performance issues, including slow queries, indexing bottlenecks, and relevance degradation

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Build and deploy cloud-native applications on AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, Cognito, etc.)
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code (CloudFormation, Terraform, or CDK) to support reliable, repeatable deployments

Education Requirement

Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent education and work experience.

Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills

  • 5-10+ years of professional software development experience
  • Strong proficiency in .NET Core (C#), including asynchronous patterns and dependency-injection frameworks
  • Proven experience designing and developing secure, scalable RESTful APIs for internal and client-facing systems
  • Experience with authentication, entitlements, and access control systems
  • Solid experience with AWS services and strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases
  • Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies, and DevOps/CI/CD pipelines
  • Must have worked with AI-assisted development tools (Claude, Copilot, Codex, etc.)

Preferred Experience, Knowledge And Skills

  • Familiarity with Apache Solr, OpenSearch, or Elasticsearch (schema design, indexing, query parsing, clustering)
  • Understanding of search relevance concepts: tokenization, stemming, analyzers, and boosting strategies
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (CloudFormation, Terraform, CDK) and containerization (Docker, ECS, EKS)
  • Knowledge of event-driven architectures (SNS, SQS, EventBridge) and observability tools (CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk)
  • Knowledge of search in construction or AEC industry datasets

About Dodge Construction Network

Dodge Construction Network exists to deliver the comprehensive data and connections the construction industry needs to build thriving communities. Our legacy is deeply rooted in empowering our customers with transformative insights, igniting their journey towards unparalleled business expansion and success. We serve decision-makers who seek reliable growth and who value relationships built on trust and quality. By combining our proprietary data with cutting-edge software, we deliver to our customers the essential intelligence needed to excel within their respective landscapes. We propel the construction industry forward by transforming data into tangible guidance, driving unparalleled advancement.

Dodge is the catalyst for modern construction.

4452807378.descriptionHtml:
Java Full Stack Developer

Claidroid Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Trivandrum, Kerala

Work Mode: Hybrid

Experience: 4–6 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time


We’re Hiring: Java Full Stack Developer

Claidroid Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is hiring experienced Java Full Stack Developers for a strategic enterprise technology engagement with a leading global client.


This opportunity is ideal for full-stack professionals with strong hands-on experience across Java, Spring Framework, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, and modern frontend technologies such as Angular or React.


The role involves contributing across the complete application lifecycle, including design, development, integration, testing, deployment, enhancement, and production support of scalable enterprise applications. Candidates should be comfortable working in an Agile engineering environment and collaborating with multiple technology and business stakeholders.


About Claidroid Technologies

Claidroid Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a global digital transformation and technology services partner built around the pillars of Cloud, AI, and Automation.


We work with leading enterprises helping them modernize platforms, improve operational efficiency, strengthen governance, and accelerate business outcomes through scalable and high-quality technology solutions.


Our delivery approach is anchored in engineering excellence, governance, quality assurance, domain understanding, and business-aligned execution.


Role Overview

As a Java Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, enhancing, and supporting scalable full-stack enterprise applications.


You will work across both backend and frontend layers, developing robust services using Java and Spring Boot, building and integrating RESTful APIs and microservices, and creating responsive user interfaces using Angular or React.


You will collaborate closely with business analysts, architects, QA engineers, DevOps teams, product stakeholders, and other developers to translate business requirements into reliable, secure, maintainable, and performance-oriented technology solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable Java full-stack applications.
  • Develop robust backend services using Java, Spring Framework, and Spring Boot.
  • Design, build, and integrate RESTful APIs, web services, and microservices.
  • Develop responsive, maintainable, and user-friendly frontend applications using Angular or React.
  • Work with JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3 to build modern user interfaces.
  • Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and enterprise services.
  • Work with relational databases and write efficient SQL queries.
  • Participate in application design, coding, unit testing, code reviews, debugging, deployment, and production support.
  • Troubleshoot application issues and perform effective root-cause analysis.
  • Ensure application performance, scalability, security, reliability, and code quality.
  • Write clean, maintainable, secure, and well-documented code in accordance with engineering standards.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, architects, QA engineers, DevOps teams, product owners, and other engineering stakeholders.
  • Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, and technical discussions.
  • Follow coding standards, development best practices, secure development principles, and version-control processes.
  • Support deployment activities and contribute to CI/CD pipelines and automation initiatives.
  • Prepare and maintain relevant technical documentation.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of development practices, tooling, automation, and engineering quality.


Key Skills and Experience

  • 4–6 years of relevant hands-on experience in Java Full Stack development.
  • Strong programming experience in Java / Java 8+.
  • Strong knowledge of Spring Framework and Spring Boot.
  • Hands-on experience developing RESTful APIs / Web Services.
  • Good understanding of Microservices Architecture.
  • Experience with Hibernate / JPA.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, design principles, and software engineering practices.
  • Hands-on frontend development experience with Angular or React.
  • Strong working knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Experience integrating frontend applications with REST APIs.
  • Good experience with relational databases such as Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server.
  • Strong understanding of SQL and database concepts.
  • Experience with version-control platforms such as Git, GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
  • Experience using Maven or Gradle.
  • Familiarity with unit-testing frameworks such as JUnit and Mockito.
  • Experience using API testing tools such as Postman.
  • Understanding of CI/CD concepts and exposure to tools such as Jenkins.
  • Experience working in Agile / Scrum development environments.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with business and technology stakeholders.


Good to Have

  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Knowledge of Kafka or other messaging technologies.
  • Familiarity with SonarQube or similar code-quality tools.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks.
  • Understanding of application security and secure coding practices.
  • Exposure to production support, performance optimisation, and application monitoring.
  • Experience in enterprise-scale application development or modernization initiatives.
  • Familiarity with Agile collaboration tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
  • Prior experience in the insurance, BFSI, or financial services domain will be an advantage.


Candidate Profile

  • 4–6 years of relevant Java Full Stack development experience.
  • Strong hands-on capability across both backend and frontend application development.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
  • Good understanding of the software development lifecycle and modern engineering practices.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a cross-functional team.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
  • Comfortable working in Agile and enterprise delivery environments.
  • Willingness to work from Trivandrum, Kerala, as required by the project and client delivery model.


Why Join Claidroid Technologies?

At Claidroid Technologies, you will have the opportunity to work on meaningful enterprise technology initiatives for global clients.


You will be part of a quality-driven and collaborative delivery environment where technical excellence, ownership, accountability, governance, and continuous learning are valued.


This opportunity provides exposure to enterprise Java development, modern frontend engineering, microservices, cloud-native technologies, secure application delivery, Agile engineering practices, automation, and business-critical technology platforms.


Work Location

Trivandrum, Kerala – Hybrid

Candidates should be open to working from the office as required by the project and client delivery model.


Preferred Candidates

  • Candidates with 4–6 years of strong Java Full Stack development experience.
  • Candidates with strong hands-on expertise in Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, and Angular or React.
  • Candidates with experience in Hibernate/JPA, SQL, Git, Maven/Gradle, JUnit/Mockito, and CI/CD practices.
  • Candidates with exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, Kafka, or SonarQube will have an advantage.
  • Candidates with prior insurance, BFSI, or financial services domain experience will be preferred.
  • Immediate or early joiners will be preferred.
  • Candidates currently based in or willing to work from Trivandrum / Kerala will be preferred.


Preferred Qualification

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

4458375489.descriptionHtml:
About The Role

We are looking for a young, highly tech-savvy and curious IT & Technology Associate to join our team.

This is not a conventional IT support role limited to fixing computers, printers and networks.

While the person will assist with our day-to-day IT infrastructure, a significant part of the role will involve working on the company's technology, software, automation and digital transformation projects.

The successful candidate will work closely with management, our internal teams and external software developers/vendors to help translate business requirements into practical technology solutions.

We are open to hiring a fresh graduate. Previous corporate experience is not essential. What matters considerably more is technical aptitude, curiosity, problem-solving ability and the ability to learn new technologies quickly.

Key Responsibilities

Software & Development Projects

  • Work with management on new software and technology initiatives across the company.
  • Liaise with external software developers, vendors and implementation partners.
  • Understand business requirements and communicate them clearly to developers.
  • Follow up on development projects, testing, bugs, modifications and implementation.
  • Test new software features before deployment and provide structured feedback.
  • Assist with API integrations and connections between different business systems.
  • Gradually develop the capability to work across front-end, back-end and full-stack development.
  • Understand existing code and learn to make minor modifications or develop internal applications where required.

Automation & AI

  • Identify repetitive processes that can be automated.
  • Help develop workflows connecting different applications and departments.
  • Explore APIs, webhooks and integration platforms.
  • Experiment with practical applications of AI and automation within the business.
  • Assist management in evaluating new technology platforms and software.

Business Systems

Work with and gradually develop expertise across the company's various technology platforms, including areas such as:

  • CRM
  • Accounting integrations
  • HR systems
  • Cargo and logistics software
  • Courier systems
  • Reporting and analytics
  • Workflow automation
  • Internal databases and applications

The candidate is not expected to know all these systems when joining. The ability to learn them quickly is more important.

IT Infrastructure & Support

The role will also provide support for our existing office IT environment, including:

  • Computers and laptops
  • Windows
  • Microsoft 365
  • Printers and scanners
  • LAN/Wi-Fi/networking
  • Internet connectivity
  • Routers and access points
  • User accounts and access
  • Software installation
  • Basic hardware troubleshooting
  • Data backup and security
  • Coordination with hardware/network vendors where required

The objective is not necessarily to personally repair every piece of equipment, but to take ownership of IT issues and ensure they are resolved.

What We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in candidates who are:

  • Naturally interested in technology.
  • Fast learners who can pick up unfamiliar software quickly.
  • Comfortable experimenting and figuring things out independently.
  • Logical problem solvers.
  • Comfortable communicating with software developers.
  • Interested in coding and software development.
  • Willing to learn full-stack development.
  • Interested in APIs, automation and AI.
  • Comfortable working across both technology and business operations.
  • Organised enough to follow development projects through to completion.
  • Able to communicate clearly in English.
  • Comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting for detailed instructions for every task.

Technical Background

Candidates May Come From Backgrounds Such As

B.Tech / BE – Computer Science / IT

BCA

BSc Computer Science

MCA

or another relevant technology qualification

Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.

Basic exposure to some of the following would be advantageous:

  • HTML / CSS / JavaScript
  • Python
  • PHP / Node.js or similar technologies
  • SQL and databases
  • REST APIs
  • Git/GitHub
  • Basic cloud concepts
  • Networking
  • Microsoft 365
  • Zoho applications
  • Low-code/no-code automation platforms
  • AI development tools

We do not expect a fresher to know everything listed above.

A candidate who understands programming fundamentals and can demonstrate that they learn extremely quickly may be more suitable for us than someone with several years of experience but limited curiosity.

The Kind of Candidate We Want

We are looking for the person who, when given an unfamiliar technical problem, says:

"I haven't done this before, but give me some time and I'll figure it out."

The role will suit someone who enjoys learning how systems work, experimenting with technology and gradually taking responsibility for increasingly complex projects.

Over time, we expect this person to become an important link between management, operations and our software development partners.

Growth Opportunity

This position has significant room to grow.

A Promising Candidate Could Progressively Move From

IT Support & Systems

→ Automation & Integrations

→ Software Development

→ Full-Stack Development

→ Technology Project Management

→ Internal Technology Lead

We are prepared to invest time in developing the right person.

In return, we expect curiosity, initiative, accountability and continuous learning.

How We Would Prefer To Evaluate Candidates

For fresh graduates, academic marks alone will not determine selection.

We Would Particularly Like To Hear About

  • Projects you have built
  • Applications/websites you have experimented with
  • GitHub projects
  • College projects
  • Automations you have created
  • Problems you solved using technology
  • Technologies you taught yourself
  • How you currently use AI tools for coding and problem solving

Even unfinished personal projects are welcome.

Show us what you can build, how you think, and how quickly you can learn.

Skills: technology,it,developers

4450463224.descriptionHtml:
Job Purpose

The Principal Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for driving the design, implementation, and management of scalable, secure, and highly available AI solutions that power AOT’s portfolio of digital products for the public and private sectors. This role blends deep technical expertise with strategic thinking and hands-on leadership — setting architectural direction, championing AI-assisted engineering practices, and mentoring engineers to build the next generation of intelligent, cloud-native applications. The Principal Engineer partners closely with the Head of Engineering, product leaders and cross-functional teams to translate complex business and user needs into resilient, future-ready technical solutions grounded in open-source principles and modern cloud architecture.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end design, architecture and delivery of scalable, secure and highly available AI-powered solutions across AOT’s product portfolio.
  • Define and evolve the technical vision for AI/ML platforms, including LLM-based applications, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows and ML model lifecycle management.
  • Architect distributed, cloud-native systems leveraging AWS, Azure, and/or GCP — ensuring high availability, fault tolerance, observability and cost efficiency across multi-cloud environments.
  • Champion the adoption of AI-assisted development practices (e.g.Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or other agentic coding tools) to accelerate engineering velocity and elevate code quality across teams.
  • Drive the evaluation, selection and integration of open-source frameworks, libraries, and platforms to build sustainable, vendor-agnostic solutions aligned with AOT’s hybrid-source philosophy.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership — writing production-grade code, building proof-of-concepts and prototypes, reviewing pull requests and shaping critical design decisions across multiple teams.
  • Establish engineering excellence standards across security, performance, scalability, observability, accessibility and privacy compliance — with special focus on responsible and ethical AI practices.
  • Mentor and grow senior engineers, tech leads and architects through coaching, design reviews, technical deep-dives and structured feedback — building a strong engineering bench.
  • Partner with the Head of Engineering, Product and Solutions teams to align technical strategy with business outcomes, customer needs and long-term product roadmaps.
  • Lead cross-team architectural reviews and serve as the principal authority on technical trade-offs, build-vs-buy decisions and platform standardization.
  • Define and guide DevOps, SRE and MLOps practices — including CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, model deployment, monitoring and continuous evaluation of AI systems.
  • Stay at the forefront of emerging trends in Generative AI, LLMs, agentic systems, and applied ML — actively bringing innovation back into AOT’s products and engineering culture.
  • Represent AOT’s engineering organization in technical forums, customer conversations, open-source communities, and industry events as needed.
  • Champion a culture of psychological safety, continuous learning, experimentation, open knowledge-sharing, and shared ownership of outcomes.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Experience

  • 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years in a Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer or Enterprise Architect role.
  • Proven track record of architecting and delivering large-scale, production-grade AI/ML or data-intensive solutions in cloud environments.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and operating highly available, distributed systems serving enterprise or public sector customers.
  • Hands-on experience leading the productionization of AI/ML workloads — including LLM-based applications, RAG systems, vector databases, prompt engineering, fine-tuning or agentic workflows.

Technical Skills

  • Deep expertise in scalable architecture patterns: microservices, event-driven systems, distributed computing, caching, queueing and high-throughput data pipelines.
  • Strong proficiency across multiple cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) — including compute, storage, networking, identity, container orchestration (Kubernetes, ECS, AKS), and managed AI/ML services (Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI).
  • Strong hands-on coding ability in one or more modern backend languages/frameworks such as Python, Java, Node.js or Go.
  • Working knowledge of frontend frameworks such as React, Vue, or Angular, and the ability to reason about full-stack performance and architecture.
  • Practical experience with AI/ML frameworks and ecosystems: PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Hugging Face, LangChain/LlamaIndex, OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock APIs, vector databases.
  • Strong command of AI-assisted development tools and workflows (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor or any other agentic coding agents) and ability to operationalize them across an engineering organization.
  • Solid understanding of DevOps, SRE and MLOps practices: CI/CD, IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), observability (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) and model monitoring.
  • Deep understanding of secure coding practices, identity and access management, data privacy, accessibility and compliance frameworks relevant to enterprise and public sector software.
  • Experience with process orchestration and workflow tools (e.g., M8Flow, Camunda, Airflow, Temporal) is a strong plus.

Leadership & Communication

  • Proven ability to lead through influence — driving alignment across engineering teams, product, design and executive stakeholders without direct reporting authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong mentorship and coaching skills, with a track record of growing senior engineers and tech leads.
  • Skilled in agile development methodologies and iterative, customer-centric delivery.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying agentic AI systems, multi-agent orchestration or tool-using LLM applications in production.
  • Experience contributing to or leading open-source projects, or managing hybrid-source software portfolios.
  • Background in low-code/no-code platforms, BPMN-based process automation (e.g., Camunda, M8Flow), or workflow orchestration products.
  • Familiarity with government digital standards, procurement environments, and compliance regimes (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, FedRAMP).
  • Exposure to responsible AI practices — bias evaluation, model governance, AI safety, and red-teaming of LLM systems.
  • Experience presenting at conferences, publishing technical content, or contributing to industry communities around AI, cloud or software architecture.
  • Certifications in cloud architecture (AWS/Azure/GCP) or AI engineering are an added advantage.

Working Conditions

  • Work Arrangement: This is an opportunity based out of our Trivandrum office.
  • Travel Requirements: Occasional travel may be required for team meetings, customer engagements, industry conferences or knowledge-sharing forums.
  • On-Call Requirements: Light on-call rotation may be required to support critical production systems, depending on operational needs.
  • Hours of Work: Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week, with overlap with PST required as needed to collaborate with global teams.

Living AOT’s Values

Role

Our values guide how we work, collaborate, and grow as a team. Every role at AOT is expected to embody and promote these values:

  • Innovation: We pursue true innovation by solving problems and meeting unarticulated needs.
  • Integrity: We hold ourselves to high ethical standards and never compromise.
  • Ownership: We are all responsible for our shared long-term success.
  • Agility: We stay ready to adapt to change and deliver results.
  • Collaboration: We believe collaboration and knowledge-sharing fuel innovation and success.
  • Empowerment: We support our people so they can bring the best of themselves to work every day.

4451397512.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Senior Java Backend Engineer with strong experience in Java, Spring, MongoDB and IBM WebSphere Commerce (WCS) to support a major platform modernisation initiative.

The team is migrating away from WCS as the source of truth towards a modern backend stack based on Java/Spring and MongoDB. The key requirement is strong hands-on WCS knowledge, particularly around the underlying infrastructure, codebase, build and deployment processes, and access management.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Work as part of a team migrating functionality and data away from WCS as the source of truth.
  • Develop and maintain backend services using Java and Spring/Spring Boot.
  • Work with MongoDB as part of the target backend architecture.
  • Analyse and navigate the existing WCS codebase to understand business logic, integrations and dependencies.
  • Provide technical guidance on WCS infrastructure and architecture.
  • Understand and support existing WCS build, deployment and release processes.
  • Troubleshoot WCS environments and resolve infrastructure/application issues.
  • Support access, configuration and environment management across WCS.
  • Help identify and migrate relevant functionality from WCS into the new Java/Spring/MongoDB stack.
  • Collaborate with engineering, architecture and DevOps teams throughout the migration.
  • Contribute to improving build, deployment and operational processes.
  • Support the team in reducing dependency on WCS and transitioning towards the new platform.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience as a Senior Java Backend Engineer.
  • Hands-on experience with Java and Spring/Spring Boot.
  • Strong experience with MongoDB or similar NoSQL databases.
  • Strong hands-on experience with IBM WebSphere Commerce (WCS) is essential.
  • Good understanding of WCS infrastructure and environments.
  • Experience navigating and troubleshooting large WCS codebases.
  • Strong understanding of WCS build and deployment processes.
  • Experience managing or troubleshooting WCS access and environment configuration.
  • Experience working on complex enterprise e-commerce platforms.
  • Ability to understand existing legacy systems and support migration to modern architectures.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience with DevOps / CI/CD.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, pipelines and deployment automation.
  • Experience with containerisation and Kubernetes.
  • Experience in e-commerce / retail environments.
  • Experience migrating from legacy commerce platforms to modern microservices architectures.

Benefits

We offer

  • Flexible working hours (self-managed)
  • Annual bonus, subject to company performance
  • Access to Udemy online training and opportunities to learn and grow within the role

At Mindera we use technology to build products we are proud of, with people we love.

Software Engineering Applications, including Web and Mobile, are at the core of what we do at Mindera.

We partner with our clients, to understand their products and deliver high-performance, resilient and scalable software systems that create an impact on their users and businesses across the world.

You get to work with a bunch of great people, and the whole team owns the project together.

Our culture reflects our lean and self-organisation attitude.

We encourage our colleagues to take risks, make decisions, work in a collaborative way and talk to everyone to enhance communication. We are proud of our work and we love to learn all and everything while navigating through an Agile, Lean and collaborative environment.

Our offices are located: Porto, Portugal | Aveiro, Portugal | Coimbra, Portugal | Leicester, UK | San Diego, USA | Chennai, India | Bengaluru, India

4424935501.descriptionHtml:
At Charles River, we are passionate about improving the quality of people’s lives. When you join our global family, you will help create healthier lives for millions of patients and their families.

Charles River employees are innovative thinkers, who are dedicated to continuous learning and improvement. We will empower you with the resources you need to grow and develop in your career.

As a Charles River employee, you will be part of an industry-leading, customer-focused company at the forefront of drug development. Your skills will play a key role in bringing life-saving therapies to market faster through simpler, quicker, and more digitalized processes. Whether you are in lab operations, finance, IT, sales, or another area, when you work at Charles River, you will be the difference every day for patients across the globe.

Job Overview

Are you an expert in Java J2EE applications, with proven skills in large scale modernization of corporate systems?

Would you like to apply your expertise to play an integral part in ensuring full system stability within a cGMP regulated environment?

Charles River Laboratories are excited to be recruiting for a Senior Full Stack Java Developer on a full time, permanent basis. You will be leading the modernization, troubleshooting and maintenance of the Java J2EE LIMS application with a predominant focus on the conversion of legacy EJB components to RESTful services. Using a deep technical knowledge of Java J2EE development, you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement best practice and ensure compliance with industry standards.

We are looking for a Java 2EE development specialist, with knowledge of software lifecycle management in a cGMP regulated environment to lead this transition!

This position will work remote from home office, located in India.

Must be able to work US (EST / EDT) and UK (BST / GMT) hours.

Job Description

What you’ll be doing:

  • Lead the modernization of an existing 1M+ lines Java J2EE application, transitioning from EJBs to RESTful APIs.
  • Drive the UI migration from Swing to modern JS/TS web framework using WebSwing, ensuring a seamless user experience.
  • Develop and maintain microservices architecture, optimizing performance and scalability.
  • Work with Spring, WildFly, and PostgreSQL to enhance backend functionality.
  • Implement best practices for software development, ensuring compliance with FDA guidelines, cGMP 21 CFR Part 11, MHRA, and GAMP5.
  • Ensure software documentation, change control procedures, and regulatory requirements are met.
  • Collaborate with Quality Assurance (QA) and regulatory teams to maintain compliance and data integrity.
  • Work closely with business analysts, operations, and external vendors to align software development with business needs.
  • Lead training and knowledge transfer sessions to ensure effective adoption of new technologies.
  • Participate in Agile development processes and contribute to continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
  • Perform all other related duties as assigned.

Skills And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Java J2EE development, with expertise in:
  • EJB-to-REST conversion
  • Spring framework
  • WildFly or similar Java EE application servers
  • Swing UI modernization to JS/TS web framework (preferably migrating to Svelte)
  • Strong experience with SQL databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and RESTful API development.

Technical Skills

  • Expertise in object-oriented programming (OOP) and design patterns.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript, ReactJS, Svelte, or other modern frontend frameworks.
  • Knowledge of unit testing, integration testing, and automated end-to-end testing.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) tools.

Desirable

  • Development in a GxP-regulated environment.
  • Experience working with LIMS (Laboratory Information Management Systems).
  • Understanding of cloud-based solutions and DevOps practices.

About Corporate Functions

The Corporate Functions provide operational support across Charles River in areas such as Human Resources, Finance, IT, Legal, Sales, Quality Assurance, Marketing, and Corporate Development. They partner with their colleagues across the company to develop and drive strategies and to set global standards. The functions are essential to providing a bridge between strategic vision and operational readiness, to ensure ongoing functional innovation and capability improvement.

About Charles River

Charles River is an early-stage contract research organization (CRO). We have built upon our foundation of laboratory animal medicine and science to develop a diverse portfolio of discovery and safety assessment services, both Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and non-GLP, to support clients from target identification through preclinical development. Charles River also provides a suite of products and services to support our clients’ clinical laboratory testing needs and manufacturing activities. Utilizing this broad portfolio of products and services enables our clients to create a more flexible drug development model, which reduces their costs, enhances their productivity and effectiveness to increase speed to market.

With over 20,000 employees within 110 facilities in over 20 countries around the globe, we are strategically positioned to coordinate worldwide resources and apply multidisciplinary perspectives in resolving our client’s unique challenges. Our client base includes global pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, government agencies and hospitals and academic institutions around the world.

At Charles River, we are passionate about our role in improving the quality of people’s lives. Our mission, our excellent science and our strong sense of purpose guide us in all that we do, and we approach each day with the knowledge that our work helps to improve the health and well-being of many across the globe. We have proudly worked on 80% of the drugs approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in the past five years.

We’re committed to providing benefits that elevate your quality of life. Based on your position these may include: bonus/incentives based on performance, 401K, paid time off, stock purchase program, Health and wellness coverage, employee and family wellbeing support programs, and work life balance flexibility.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Charles River is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, sex, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, mental or physical disability, family status, pregnancy, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

It is unlawful in some states (including Massachusetts) to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

If you are interested in applying to Charles River Laboratories and need special assistance or an accommodation due to a disability to complete any forms or to otherwise participate in the resume submission process, please contact a member of our Human Resources team by sending an e-mail message to crrecruitment_US@crl.com. This contact is for accommodation requests for individuals with disabilities only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

For more information, please visit www.criver.com.

Work Location: Kochi/Trivandrum/Bangalore-Remote

Looking for immediate joiners


Job Description / Duties and Responsibilities


▪ Design, analyze, develop and deploy new features for the product.

▪ Lead engineer role in managing tasks in a sprint, reviewing the code of team members, and ensuring first time quality of code.

▪ Actively participate in the Agile ceremonies like the sprint planning, story grooming, daily scrums or standup meetings, Retrospective meeting, and Sprint reviews.

▪ Connect with stakeholders to understand requirements and produce technical specifications based on the business requirements.

▪ Write “clean”, well-designed code.

▪ Follow technology best practices.

▪ Follow modern agile based development process including automated unit testing.

▪ Take complete ownership of the tasks, user stories committed by self/team.

▪ Understand the development processes agreed at the organization/client level and ensure that these are followed diligently in the project. Actively participate in optimizing and evolving this process for the improvement of project execution.

▪ Understand user stories, translate that into technical specifications and convert this into working code.

▪ Troubleshoot, test, and maintain the core product software and databases to ensure strong optimization and functionality.

▪ Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle.

▪ Follow industry trends and tools, pilot them and ensure that team can scale up technically to absorb technology best practices over time.

▪ Readiness to take up initiative for suggesting and implementing the best practices in the areas of respective technology.

▪ Expertise in developing Java Framework and Angular based web applications with RDBMS or NoSQL database back-end.

▪ Strong skills in Java, Web API, HTML 5, CSS, JavaScript technologies.

▪ Proven Expertise in Java 21, Gradle, Angular 19, Spring boot MVC, Spring data, Hibernate, PostgresSQL.

▪ Excellent development experience using web and JavaScript technologies expertise with HTML/XHTML, XML, JSON, CSS, JavaScript, AJAX, DOM, and version control systems (such as git, visual code).

▪ Good working exposure with REST API and very strong knowledge in object-oriented concepts & design patterns.

▪ Good understanding of Angular concepts – Interceptors, Pipes, Directives, Decorators etc.

▪ Experience with Docker, AWS S3, AWS Secrets Manager and Cloudwatch.

▪ Experience in writing Unit test case using Jasmine/Karma or Jest is a plus.

▪ Demonstrated willingness to learn and develop with new/unfamiliar technologies.

▪ Well versed with troubleshooting issues and debugging the Java script code.

▪ Understands impacts of performance-based designs, accessibility standards and security compliance in development.

▪ Good understanding and working knowledge on project tracking tools like JIRA, Azure DevOps, and project collaboration tools like Confluence etc.

▪ Excellent communication skills and convey the ideas with clarity, depth, and details.

▪ Understanding of Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery best practices, and experience in setting up a CI/CD to speed up software development and deployment process, using Jenkins, GitHub, plugins etc.

▪ Exposure to AWS ecosystem and services.

▪ To adhere to ISMS policies and procedures

4377681591.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually..

About The Role

Engineering at Moniepoint is an inspired, customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. Our infrastructure runs on some of the cool tools that excite infrastructure engineers - Kubernetes, Docker, etc.

We also make business decisions based on the large stream of data we receive daily, so we work daily with big data, perform data analytics and build models to make sense of the noise and give our customers the best experience.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (Product, Design, and QA) to conceptualize, design, and deliver high-impact features.
  • Architect and build scalable, high-performance backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Produce clean, maintainable, and well-documented code with a strong emphasis on reliability and testability.
  • Seamlessly integrate third-party services and APIs, ensuring robust error handling and graceful degradation.
  • Continuously enhance system performance and developer experience through thoughtful automation and refactoring.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex issues across the stack while proactively identifying opportunities for technical improvements.
  • Actively contribute to code reviews and architecture discussions, promoting engineering best practices across the team.
  • Maintain clear documentation of technical decisions, systems, and processes to support transparency and long-term scalability.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years of hands-on professional experience in software engineering, with a strong emphasis on backend development.
  • Deep expertise in Java and Spring Boot, with a solid grasp of modern backend architecture and engineering best practices.
  • Proven experience designing, building, and scaling web services, RESTful APIs, and distributed systems.
  • Working knowledge of Agile development methodologies and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong proficiency with relational databases and ORM frameworks (e.g., Hibernate).
  • Exposure to frontend technologies such as AngularJS or React is a plus.
  • Excellent debugging and troubleshooting abilities, with a structured approach to problem-solving.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative, team-first mindset.

Our Tech Stack

As part of our engineering team, you’ll work with modern technologies and tools that enable us to build scalable, reliable, and high-performing systems. Some of the technologies you’ll be hands-on with include

  • Java (latest versions): Powers our core backend systems with a strong emphasis on performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Spring & Spring Boot: Enables the development of modular, production-ready microservices with robust dependency management.
  • Docker & Kubernetes: Supports containerized deployments and orchestration, ensuring consistent and scalable environments across development, staging, and production.
  • PostgreSQL & DynamoDB: Leverages both relational and NoSQL databases to efficiently manage structured data and dynamic scaling requirements.
  • Elasticsearch: Delivers fast, flexible full-text search and real-time analytics across large datasets.
  • AWS Cloud Infrastructure: Facilitates cloud-native deployment and management of microservices designed for high availability and global scalability.

What We Can Offer You

  • Culture - We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
  • Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
  • Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, paid leave, plus other benefits.

What To Expect In The Hiring Process

Our interview process is designed to be thoughtful, transparent, and candidate-friendly, allowing you to showcase your strengths while getting to know us better:

  • Initial Conversation: A brief introductory call with our recruiter to learn more about your background, career goals, and to share insights about the role and our team.
  • Technical Assessment: A practical, take-home coding exercise that reflects real-world challenges. You'll have ample time to complete this in your own environment
  • Deep Dive Technical Interview: A focused session with our Engineering Team, where we'll explore system design, architecture, and problem-solving approaches.
  • Final Interview: A combined technical and behavioural conversation with a member of our Executive Team, aimed at understanding your alignment with our values, vision, and culture

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Description

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join one of our software businesses within TAG Software Group.

You will design, develop, and support software solutions used by customers worldwide across multiple industries. Working closely with product, architecture, and engineering teams, you will help modernize the platform through cloud technologies, APIs, automation, and mobile solutions. The successful candidate will be a hands-on engineer with strong technical skills, a passion for quality, and the ability to contribute across the full software development lifecycle.

About Tag Software Group

TAG Software Group is a team of experienced investors and operators dedicated to acquiring, enhancing, and growing mission-critical software companies serving SMB, enterprise, and public sector customers.

Founded as part of a permanent home for software companies, we don’t buy to sell. Our focus is on long-term partnerships that protect your legacy, employees, and customers.

Our in-house team delivers an efficient, transparent, and seller-friendly process, ensuring speed and certainty of close. Once part of TAG, your company gains access to proven best practices, dedicated value-creation resources, and the extended ecosystem of our sister companies, including proprietary in-house technology including and — helping your business reach the next level.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable software solutions used by a global customer base across multiple industries.
  • Collaborate with product, architecture, and engineering teams to define requirements and deliver high-quality features.
  • Contribute to the modernization of existing platforms through cloud-based technologies and modern software architecture.
  • Build and integrate APIs and backend services to support seamless system functionality and extensibility.
  • Develop automation solutions to improve deployment efficiency, system reliability, and operational performance.
  • Participate in the design and development of mobile and cross-platform applications where applicable.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following best practices and engineering standards.
  • Support the full software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex technical issues across distributed systems.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives in engineering practices, tooling, and development processes.
  • Ensure software quality through code reviews, testing strategies, and adherence to secure coding practices.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, customer-focused software solutions.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of software development experience.
  • Strong experience with Java and Spring Boot.
  • Experience developing REST APIs and microservices.
  • Experience with SQL and relational databases.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, and Agile development.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS or Azure.
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with Angular, React, or modern web frameworks.
  • Experience developing SaaS applications.

Benefits

WHY JOIN US:

  • Work on impactful software used by customers worldwide across a diverse range of industries and use cases.
  • Be part of a collaborative engineering culture, working closely with product, architecture, and engineering teams to shape meaningful solutions.
  • Contribute directly to modernizing a growing platform through cloud technologies, APIs, automation, and mobile capabilities.
  • Gain hands-on experience across the full software development lifecycle, from design and development to deployment and support.
  • Join a team that values technical excellence, quality craftsmanship, and continuous improvement in everything we build.
  • Take ownership of real engineering challenges in a role where your work directly influences product direction and customer outcomes.

#TagSoftwareGroup
